name: Spaceship 25e004f4 on the 3-uniform tiling k3-013
description: A period-4 spaceship on the 3-uniform tiling k3-013 (touching neighbours), 7 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 4,096 rules from B45/S34 to B4,5,8,9,10,11,12/S0,3,4,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-019. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 198 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
